scripts.frontend: sh -c 'if [ ! -f apps/web/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js ] || [ ! -f apps/web/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc ]; then npm --prefix apps/web install --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund || exit 1; fi; cd apps/web && npm run dev'
scripts.services: sh -c 'export SYSTUTOR_DATABASE_URL="${SYSTUTOR_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql+psycopg://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/librefact}"; if [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then . .venv/bin/activate; fi; cd vendor/systutor-core && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'
scripts.dev: npm run services & npm run frontend
